summary:
The selected F# source adds one finite read-only attention invocation for an explicitly identified, already-running GitHub Actions run/attempt. Core reduces observations; the GitHub adapter reads native facts; the existing engine CLI owns local continuation. Exact input retains owning issue/body update and digest, source, owner, slice/original attempt, PR/head, run/attempt, population revision and original Unknown identifiers. These attributed inputs and the cursor confer no authority. No scheduler, model callback per pending tick, arbitrary command recipe, dispatch, retry, Status write, reservation release or merge-readiness decision is added.
The original 1–600-second window includes a 500ms cleanup reserve; it starts with 384 requests and 4MiB accepted evidence/result output. Linux boot identity and monotonic ticks bind continuation. Resume retains absolute work/cleanup deadlines and remaining budgets, refusing changed identity/clock, backwards time, corrupt or expired custody before native reads. Requests are charged and persisted before sending; a crash may spend allowance without progress but cannot replenish it. Pending progress stays internal, with waits at most five seconds; actionable change, terminal observation, gap or deadline returns one compact attention result.
An ordinary complete sample uses two owning-issue reads, two PR reads, two run reads and two complete selected-attempt job sweeps: eight GETs through 100 jobs, ten for 101–128. Pages are constructed explicitly, complete counts and unique identities are checked, and each job binds run/attempt/head. Population disagreement, incomplete/unsupported observations or completion across the run/jobs barrier cannot become positive completion. This is the selected run population, not every required PR check. Each GET uses at most 30 seconds within remaining work time. The reused transport may transiently acquire 4MiB; only pages of at most 256KiB are accepted before parsing. The latter is not an acquisition cap or a process memory bound.
For a sample-derived terminal, output charge is persisted with Terminal/Evidence cleared, then evidence is written, then the terminal and evidence reference are persisted. A hard interruption before evidence custody resumes native observation from the retained pending cursor; it cannot replay an unretained positive sample. Durable terminal attention replays its stable identity only within the original window. Deadline checks after evidence/persistence and before final output prevent late completion delivery. Local checksum, exclusive lock and flushed file replacement do not establish hostile-tamper protection, directory/disk-loss durability or exactly-once delivery.
The original Unknowns and reservations remain untouched. Existing Python observation remains a separate bounded rollback route and cannot consume this cursor or renew an expired window. Source review is distinct from required CI, coherent publication, verified installed caller/instruction discovery and necessary real observation/restart/deadline/rollback acceptance. No native acceptance, whole-family economic benefit or current operational permission follows from this record.
title: Finite original-operation observation retains clocks, budgets and uncertainty without execution authority
